answer: Carve a basalt vault that opens only at a summit: joining locks 800 POA for 60 days, then climbs a ladder of 5 sequential tasks, each hashing into the next, taking 48 hours since every rung binds its own key. Weekly, members co-sign one checkpoint in a single 10-minute window; missing two summits in a row slashes 200 POA to attenders. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 800,000 POA for two months and burns 48,000 hours of climbing no script can compress. Like a vault that opens only when every climber stands on the summit at once, one forger can carry one pack up, never a thousand.
